architectural_principle: Cross-capability communication is exclusively async events. Within a capability, services communicate freely.

design_decisions.decision: SVC-015 owns CddReviewCase and orchestrates the review workflow. It calls SVC-014 internally (same capability) for identity verification and screening.
design_decisions.rationale: Both SVC-015 and SVC-014 are within CAP-005 (Compliance). Internal synchronous calls are permitted within a capability boundary.

consumed_events.name: CddReviewTriggered
consumed_events.purpose: JRN-020: Pre-load existing KYC record for analyst review. Prepare screening inputs from current KycAssessment.
consumed_events.maps_to: KycAssessment for client_id — pre-loaded into review case context

design_decisions.decision: SVC-014 consumes CddReviewTriggered to prepare the KYC context. It updates KycAssessment when CddReviewCompleted is received.
design_decisions.rationale: SVC-014 is the authoritative owner of KycAssessment. It reacts to review outcomes to keep the current state current.

consumed_events.name: CddRiskRatingChanged
consumed_events.purpose: JRN-020: Update internal client risk flag in Commercial Banking systems. Adjust relationship exposure limits if risk_rating increased.
consumed_events.maps_to: Internal client record: risk_classification field updated to new risk_rating

consumed_events.name: CddReviewCompleted
consumed_events.purpose: JRN-020: Notify Relationship Manager of review outcome. Trigger offboarding workflow if decision = escalate_to_exit.
consumed_events.maps_to: Internal client record: cdd_status, review_decision updated

consumed_events.name: CddExitEscalated
consumed_events.purpose: JRN-020: Initiate client offboarding — close commercial accounts, close credit facilities, return funds.
consumed_events.maps_to: Client offboarding workflow initiated; account deactivation scheduled

consumed_events.name: CddReviewTriggered
consumed_events.purpose: JRN-020: Write immutable audit record of review trigger. MLR 2017 record-keeping.

consumed_events.name: CddReviewCompleted
consumed_events.purpose: JRN-020: Write immutable audit record of review completion with decision. 7-year retention.

cross_service_interaction_summary.purpose: CDD outcomes flow to Commercial Banking to update client risk status and trigger offboarding if required
SVC-014 (within CAP-005) pre-loads KYC context on review trigger. Within-capability communication.
Immutable audit logging for MLR 2017 record-keeping obligations
